signature: SUBROUTINE DGTRFS( TRANS, N, NRHS, DL, D, DU, DLF, DF, DUF, DU2,

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations:

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$     (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose = Transpose)

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: DLF
params.reference: The (n-1) multipliers that define the matrix L from the LU factorization of A as computed by DGTTRF.

params.name: DF
params.reference: The n diagonal elements of the upper triangular matrix U from the LU factorization of A.

params.name: DUF
params.reference: The (n-1) elements of the first superdiagonal of U.

params.name: DU2
params.reference: The (n-2) elements of the second superdiagonal of U.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le n$, row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`. `IPIV(i)` will always be either i or i+1; `IPIV(i) = i` indicates a row interchange was not required.

params.name: B
params.reference: The right hand side matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: X
params.reference: On entry, the solution matrix X, as computed by DGTTRS. On exit, the improved solution matrix X.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: FERR
params.reference: The estimated forward error bound for each solution vector `X(j)` (the j-th column of the solution matrix X). If XTRUE is the true solution corresponding to `X(j)`, `FERR(j)` is an estimated upper bound for the magnitude of the largest element in (`X(j)` - XTRUE) divided by the magnitude of the largest element in `X(j)`. The estimate is as reliable as the estimate for RCOND, and is almost always a slight overestimate of the true error.

params.name: BERR
params.reference: The componentwise relative backward error of each solution vector `X(j)` (i.e., the smallest relative change in any element of A or B that makes `X(j)` an exact solution).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
